Urakkasuoritukseen sisältyvät kaikki kohteen suunnitelma-asiakirjoissa esitetyt työt, materiaalit, hankinnat ja velvoitteet, ellei suunnitelmissa muuta mainita. Laitteiston tulee muodostaa toimintavalmis kokonaisuus, johon sisältyvät kuvaus-, rekonstruktio-, fuusio-, laadunvalvonta-, käyttökoulutus-, huolto- ja vastaanottotarkastuskokonaisuudet. Laitteen tulee täyttää kaikki lainsäädännön ja viranomaisvaatimusten asettamat vaatimukset. Laitteisto hankitaan Seinäjoen keskussairaalan Fysiologian ja isotooppitutkimusten yksikköön. Kuvauslaitteiston tulee soveltua planaari- ja koko kehon kuvauksiin, dynaamisiin kuvauksiin, SPET- ja SPET-TT -kuvauksiin, elliptisen/non circular-pyörähdysten ja potilaan ääriviivoja seuraaviin kuvauksiin, EKG-tahdistetuihin ja kaksoisisotooppikuvauksiin, luuston, munuaistoiminnan, sydänperfuusion, sydämenoikovirtauksen, keuhkojen perfuusion ja ventilaation, vartijaimusolmukkeiden, lisäkilpirauhasen, kilpirauhasmetastaasien ja aivojen dopamiinitransportterien gammakuvauksiin. Laitteella pitää pystyä tekemään vaimennus- ja sirontakorjattuja SPET-TT-kuvauksia. Laitteistolla tulee pystyä tekemään itsenäisiä diagnostisen kuvanlaadun TT-kuvauksia. TT:n tulee ola monileike-TT, jossa yhdellä pyörähdyksellä mitattu kollimoitu leikemäärä on vähintään 32 leikettä ja rekonstruoitu leikemäärä vähintään 64. Laitteessa tulee olla muokattavissa olevat kuvausprotokollat aikuisille ja lapsille, annosmodulaatio, iteratiivinen tai tekoälypohjainen rekonstruktio, metalliartefaktakorjaus, vähintään 512 x 512 kuvarekonstruktiomatriisi, vähintään 50 cm diagnostinen kuvakenttä ja mahdollisuus laskennalliseen 70 cm kuvakenttään, vähintään 150 cm helikaalikuvaus ja mahdollisuus automaattisiin rekontruktoihin. Tarjottavan laitteiston tulee sisältää kaikki tarvittavat ohjelmistot, protokollat ja työasemat edellä mainittujen tutkimusten kuvaamista ja analysointia varten. Sydänperfuusio- ja aivojen reseptorikuvausohjelmistojen tulee sisältää viitearvoihin perustuvat analysointityökalut ja toimittajan on asetettava protokollat näihin sopiviksi. Laitteiston tulee olla varustettu erityisesti luuston gammakuvauksiin optimoidulla ja luustokertymien kvantitointiin soveltuvalla ohjelmistolla. Laitteiston tulee sisältää työkalut esimerkiksi keuhkojen SPET-TT -tutkimusten fuusiointiin ja analysointiin. Myyjä vastaa laitteiston soveltuvuudesta tässä mainittuun käyttötarkoitukseen.

Estimatet på 100-120 patienter årligt er et vejledende tal baseret på årgangsstørrelse, forventet forekomst af behandlingskrævende tandstillingsafvigelser samt erfaringer fra tidligere år. Leverandørerne er dog ikke garanteret nogen minimumsmængde af bestillinger. Leverandøren skal dog acceptere at modtage minimum 5 patienter pr. måned og i alt minimum 55 patienter årligt. Der forventes ingen henvisninger i juli måned. Ved aftalens indgåelse er der ophobet en mindre pulje af patienter, der er visiteret af Ordregiver i fjerde kvartal 2026 samt januar 2027 (ca. 10 patienter pr. måned), hvorfor der forventes henvisning af flere patienter ved kontraktopstart, forudsat at leverandøren/leverandørerne kan modtage patienterne. Baggrunden for at ydelserne skal leveres i Danmark er, at der arbejdes efter dansk sundhedslovgivning. Ordregiver vil indgå rammeaftale med de (op til) tre leverandører, som samlet set har afgivet de økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på tværs af de fire prissatte behandlinger i kategori 1-4. Ved henvisning af patienter vil Ordregiver først tilbyde henvisning til den bedst placerede leverandør efter kaskademodellen for henholdsvis kategorierne 1-3 og kategori 4, og kun hvis denne ikke kan levere, vil Ordregiver gå videre til den næste leverandør i rækken osv. Rammeaftalerne indgås for en periode på to (2) år med mulighed for at Ordregiver kan forlænge aftaleperioden to gange med ét (1) år. Det anslåede antal behandlingsforløb i kategori 1-4, der skal leveres i henhold til rammeaftalen, er 480 behandlinger, og det maksimale samlede antal behandlingsforløb i kategori 1-4, der skal leveres i henhold til rammeaftalen, er 600 behandlinger.

title: Ireland – Astronomical and optical instruments – Procurement of a High-Precision Optical Ground Station (OGS) Telescope Unit for Uplink and Satellite Tracking
description: The Contracting Authority is seeking tenders for the procurement of a High-Precision Optical Ground Station (OGS) Telescope Unit for Uplink and Satellite Tracking. This procurement is being undertaken as part of Phase 2 of Ireland's QCI project (TransEuroOGS), co-funded by the European Commission Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) and the Irish Department of Culture, Communications, and Sport. The successful tenderer will be required to design, manufacture, and deliver a turnkey telescope unit encompassing the mount, optics, and control software, complying with strict technical and spatial constraints. Key Technical Requirements: Optical Configuration: Ritchey-Chretien (RC) optical design, f/10 to f/12 system, with a clear aperture of at least 700 mm. Low central obstruction is required (30 percent or lower diameter linear obstruction preferred, maximum allowable 34 percent or lower). Optical Coatings and Power Handling: Broad-spectrum reflectivity covering both visible wavelengths and the 1550 nm C-Band NIR telecommunication spectrum, biased for optimal performance at 1550 nm. Reflectance at 1550 nm must be at least 95 percent (protected gold or equivalent high-efficiency NIR coating acceptable). The secondary mirror (M2) and main aperture must handle a high-power launch beam of maximum 40W continuous wave at 1550 nm across the aperture or annulus (power density less than 3300 W per square metre on the primary mirror). Focusing Path and Clear Aperture: Must feature at least one Nasmyth focus port (more preferred). The Nasmyth focus path must be completely free of refracting optical elements (100 percent reflective optics only, with removable optics as an allowable deviation). Clear aperture path through the Nasmyth axis must be at least 60 mm diameter to support downstream Adaptive Optics relay systems. Mount and Dynamic Tracking Specifications: Alt-Azimuth Direct-Drive or equivalent performance mount with low-latency tracking dynamics supporting Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite tracking, including high-elevation passes over Zenith. Minimum Azimuth Slew Rate must be at least 5 degrees per second (faster preferred). Pointing and tracking accuracy must be less than 8 to 10 arcsec RMS during dynamic LEO passes. Fastest tracking rate must exceed 1 degree per second with fine range control below this speed. Envelope and Enclosure Compatibility: Total vertical height must not exceed 3000 mm from the base to ensure dome clearance. Maximum radial swing clearance envelope must be at most 1470 mm. The axis of elevation pivot height must ensure clearance at all pointing directions, with the pivot axis positioned no more than 155 mm below the centre of the clearance envelope (or at the centre or higher). Full CAD models and opto-mechanical layout files are mandatory upon contract award. Software, Control Interface and API: Native integration with standard open-source astronomical communication protocols (INDI / INDIGO) or ASCOM / ALPACA frameworks. Open, fully documented network API adaptable to HTTP/REST or WebSocket interfaces for automated robotic control, telemetry, and scriptable trajectory loading. Ethernet data interface and DC power supply preferred. Delivery Constraint: Unit delivery must be completed within 3 to 4 months maximum from contract signature. Please refer to the detailed Technical Specification document for full technical specifications, compliance matrices, and contractual terms.

title: Denmark – Health and social work services – Genudbud af hjemmepleje og helhedspleje i Ishøj kommune
description: Dette udbud gennemføres som et genudbud efter annullation af et tidligere udbud, der blev offentliggjort den 26. juni 2026. Det tidligere udbud (TED nr. 445870-2026) blev annulleret, da ordregiver vurderede, at der var behov for væsentlige ændringer af udbudsgrundlaget. Udbuddet vedrører levering af helhedspleje, jf. ældrelovens §§ 5, 9, 10 og 11, hvilket omfatter personlig hjælp og støtte til nødvendige praktiske opgaver i hjemmet samt genoptræning af fysisk funktionsnedsættelse forårsaget af sygdom, der ikke behandles i tilknytning til en sygehusindlæggelse. Tøjvask- og indkøbsservice er ligeledes omfattet af udbuddet. Herudover omfatter udbuddet ydelser efter servicelovens § 83 samt delegerede sygeplejeydelser efter sundhedslovens § 138. Der er i udbuddet gennemført tiltag til fremme af bæredygtighed, herunder krav om overgang til emissionsfri transport for de køretøjer, der anvendes af sundheds- og plejepersonale. Kommunen forventer, at den årlige kontraktværdi udgør ca. 11,7 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Udbuddet indeholder en option på køb af sygeplejeydelser, som forventes implementeret i 2028. Der foreligger på nuværende tidspunkt ikke en konkret beskrivelse af, hvordan dette skal gennemføres, da der endnu ikke er taget politisk stilling til eller vedtaget lovgivning om, i hvilket omfang sygeplejeopgaver skal kunne varetages af private leverandører. Udbuddet er af faglige, markedsmæssige og økonomiske årsager ikke opdelt i delkontrakter. Levering af helhedspleje kræver, at mange forskellige fagligheder bringes i spil, og et betydeligt opgavevolumen er nødvendigt for, at leverandøren kan ansætte medarbejdere med de nødvendige kompetencer til at varetage opgaverne i Ishøj Kommune. Derudover ønsker Ishøj Kommune, at leverandøren påtager sig en uddannelsesforpligtelse. Et vist opgavevolumen er i den forbindelse hensigtsmæssigt, så elever, praktikanter og lærlinge kan opnå erfaring med forskellige opgavetyper. Økonomiske forhold taler ligeledes imod en opdeling. En større koncentration af borgere inden for et geografisk område giver leverandøren bedre mulighed for effektiv ruteplanlægning og reduceret transporttid (ATA-tid), hvilket samtidig kan bidrage til mere konkurrencedygtige priser for kommunen.

description: Notice of Sole Source Intent The Department of Interior (DOI), at the National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC) intends to negotiate with only one source, MillerKnoll Inc., for furniture purchase and installation to match updated furniture throughout the NIFC campus. Information received will be considered solely for the market research purposes of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Clathrate Therapeutics Platform
description: This technology from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory represents a novel platform for improving the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic gas-based treatments by enabling controlled, localized delivery at the site of disease. By addressing longstanding challenges associated with systemic exposure and dosing precision, the platform enhances the clinical viability of gas therapies across high-value markets such as oncology, cardiovascular care, and regenerative medicine. In addition, the inclusion of a complementary predictive modeling capability supports treatment optimization and development efficiency, reducing technical risk and accelerating translation. Together, these capabilities position the technology as a differentiated and scalable solution that can unlock new commercial opportunities in areas where gas-based therapeutics have shown promise but faced delivery limitations. The Opportunity: Therapeutic gases have demonstrated meaningful biological effects across oncology, cardiovascular disease, neuroprotection and regenerative medicine, yet their clinical adoption has been limited by a fundamental challenge: safe, controlled and localized delivery. Existing approaches often result in rapid release, systemic exposure or narrow therapeutic windows, creating safety, regulatory and development barriers. The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform addresses this unmet need by positioning gas-based therapies as programmable, targetable and commercially viable treatment modalities. By enabling more precise control over where and how therapeutic gases are delivered, the platform has the potential to unlock new product categories, enhance combination treatment strategies and accelerate translation of gas-based therapeutics into high-value clinical markets. How it Works: The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform uses a proprietary, controlled-release system designed to localize therapeutic gases at the intended treatment site rather than allowing them to disperse systemically. This technology temporarily stabilizes the gas within a biocompatible structure that gradually releases it under physiological conditions, enabling sustained and targeted exposure. This controlled release approach is designed to support therapeutic concentrations where needed while limiting circulating levels elsewhere in the body. An integrated computational modeling capability further supports optimization of dosing profiles and treatment parameters, helping guide development decisions prior to in vivo studies. title: 655-23-101 Site Water Loop Replacement
description: The project�s general scope of work is to furnish all tools, equipment, material, permits, labor, supervision, and all other necessary resources to accomplish the following work: This project replaces a portion of the existing campus water loop piping and existing campus water loop isolation valves. The project also includes installing a water booster pump that will be powered by a new equipment branch of emergency power in Building 22. For the new equipment branch of emergency power to be added, new wiring will feed from Building 19 (generator building) utilizing an existing underground conduit to Building 22 to feed a new emergency power distribution panel which will replace the existing emergency power distribution panel that does not meet code requirements. Installation of a new automatic transfer switch and panelboard along with wiring and conduits will be required to create the new equipment branch of emergency power. The project will also disturb many portions of the existing asphalt roadways and parking lots as well as concrete sidewalks and curbing due to excavation work. The contractor shall patch or replace asphalt and concrete as shown on the drawings and repair any areas of the landscaping and lawn that get disturbed during the project. The existing campus water loop piping is located below many of the existing campus roadways and sidewalks, and it is anticipated that most of the new piping will be as well. Therefore, this project shall be completed in phases to allow campus access for employees and Veterans and maintain water service until a tie-in to an existing building service pipe is to take place. If a shutdown of water service for any building is required during the duration of the project, it must be coordinated with the COR. Period of performance is 300 calendar days from receipt of the Notice to Proceed.
